## Summary
We are Rusty Crewmates, a company that aims to create a strong community of junior and experienced Rust and blockchain developers. 
Our objective is to make it as easy as possible for Web2 developers to migrate to Web3. To do so we hire them, teach them Substrate and find some interesting projects for them. 
We want them to become active members of the networks they contribute to as quickly as possible and with the best support they can find. In this mind we are constantly looking for blockchain features to develop and train our newcomers on.
We’ve been talking to Ramsey regarding structuring a plan that is suitable for Edgeware and Kabocha’s processes that is in line with the community first mindset and solves a specific problem for the community. 

## Network Task Teams
We aim to connect this growing talent network to Edgeware and Kabocha’s emerging ecosystem of chains, where they would work on features and proposals that are raised through on-chain bounties or tasks as we prefer. 
This project overview will be followed with specific proposals that are picked up from Trello tasks and then tracked alongside the broader task project. 
For example: 
- Rusty Crewmates Task number: RC001

We aim to also automate and decentralise this process as it develops, enabling new Task Teams to emerge who are inspired by our approach.
As a result this will become another on-chain role alongside:
- Network Service Providers
- Network Infrastr
